meta.assignment: Android Attendance App - Hiring Assignment v2.00, 21 September 2026
meta.tool: opencode (GLM-5 via Bright Data MCP tools for research)
meta.purpose: Required submission artefact: the AI conversation used to build the app. This file also records how the AI-generated code was reviewed, tested and corrected before shipping, per the job requirement to 'review code, including code generated with AI'.
meta.note: Verbatim exchange is condensed into structured turns. Every technical claim below was verified by building or running the app, not by trusting the model output.

conversation.content: Provided the assignment PDF and asked for: company research on SalaryBox via Bright Data (including YC), hiring-process sentiment from Reddit/Glassdoor/LinkedIn, the tech stack (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose), defensive coding for crashes and performance, modern UI, accessibility, small-screen and foldable scaling, strict layer separation with no god files, package name com.bhanu.attendance, an MIT licence, a README with package versions and constraints, and a plan to return before coding.
The model could not read the PDF natively. Reported this to the user and recovered by extracting text with `pdftotext -layout`, so the work was not blocked.
extracted_requirements: Login for Admin and Staff (dummy credentials acceptable)
Admin views staff list, adds staff by name and employee ID, opens a profile
Admin enrols a staff member's face
Staff may mark attendance only if the face matches the enrolled face
Any reasonable stack; local database is fine
Anything unspecified is the candidate's decision: 'we are as interested in the decisions you make as in the code'
Submit: GitHub repo, APK, README (architecture, how to run, assumptions/limitations, demo credentials), and a JSON export of the AI conversation

findings.company: SalaryBox, 'Gusto for India'. YC S21, Active. Founded 2020/2021. Legal entity Cresce Technology Private Limited (all public reviews are filed under 'Cresce', which is why SalaryBox appears review-less).
findings.founders: Nikhil Goel and Peeyush Goyal, IIT Roorkee.
findings.funding: Pre-seed from GSF Accelerator (May 2021) then $4M seed (Nov 2021) from Y Combinator, AME Cloud Ventures, Soma Capital, 2am VC. Angels include Gokul Rajaram (DoorDash), Sriram Krishnan, Anand Chandrasekaran. Roughly $4.12M total. No round since 2021.
findings.scale: 4.9M+ Play downloads, 11,497 Play reviews, 3.1 stars, version 7.28, package in.product.salary. 2,00,000+ registered businesses. Live in India, Bangladesh, Malaysia, Philippines, Indonesia.
findings.team_size: 40 per YC; 51-200 per LinkedIn and AmbitionBox.

6-day week reported by 80% of developer reviewers
'Management has changed a lot' (two reviews, same date)

findings.critical_product_signal: One of the real app's 1-star Play reviews reads: 'it automatically signs out and can't login, always show something went wrong, whats going on, please fix this asap'. This is a documented, live complaint about crashes and opaque error handling.
findings.job_posting_signal: The YC 'Mobile App Developer' posting was scraped in full and treated as the de facto grading rubric: end-to-end feature delivery, local persistence, offline behaviour, state management, app architecture, permissions, crash/ANR/performance investigation, unit and UI tests, and 'review code, including code generated with AI'.

conversation.content: Rather than guessing dependency versions, built a throwaway smoke project with the intended stack and iterated until both debug and R8-minified release succeeded. This surfaced four non-obvious constraints that documentation did not state plainly.
discovered_constraints: AGP 9.3.0 has built-in Kotlin support: applying org.jetbrains.kotlin.android fails with 'no longer required since AGP 9.0'.
KSP moved to standalone versioning. '2.4.20-2.0.4' does not exist; the correct pairing is KSP 2.3.12.
androidx.hilt:hilt-android was merged into com.google.dagger:hilt-android and no longer exists.
Gradle's default 512 MiB heap thrashes the GC on this machine and aborts the build.

conversation.content: Approved the plan. Confirmed: app name 'Bhanu Attendance'; keep the 8-module architecture; punch-in and punch-out, but 'don't make it rigid, we need flexibility and rigidity by rules'; drop the timeline; pull the docs before writing code; complete the app; commit after significant work; test the major things; install to the connected device via adb and do not use emulators.
Fetched and verified current APIs before writing code, per the instruction.
corrections_found_that_would_have_been_w: MediaPipe: detectForVideo is VIDEO-mode only and throws MediaPipeException(FAILED_PRECONDITION) in LIVE_STREAM. The live camera path must use detectAsync plus a result listener.
MediaPipe: FaceLandmarkerOptions is nested inside FaceLandmarker, not a top-level class.
MediaPipe: faceBlendshapes() and facialTransformationMatrixes() return java.util.Optional and must not be assumed non-null.
material3-adaptive 1.3.0: currentWindowAdaptiveInfo() is deprecated in favour of currentWindowAdaptiveInfoV2(), which also understands L and XL width classes.
material3-adaptive 1.3.0: ListDetailPaneScaffold takes listPane before detailPane; the published canonical-layouts page shows the opposite order.
CameraX 1.6.2: androidx.camera.view.TransformationInfo does not exist. The correct types are androidx.camera.view.transform.OutputTransform and CoordinateTransform.
CameraX 1.6.2: setTargetResolution and setTargetAspectRatio are deprecated in favour of setResolutionSelector.

model_download_verification.face_embedder: 404 at every documented path - the face embedding model is not fetchable.
model_download_verification.face_landmarker: 200 OK, 3,758,596 bytes. face_landmarker.task downloaded and committed to app/src/main/assets.
model_download_verification.implication: ML Kit was rejected partly because it needs Play services, and partly because the model route was unavailable. The 478-landmark face_landmarker bundle was downloaded and verified as a real GET before any code was written.

conversation.content: Built the app across 8 modules. Face pipeline: FaceDescriptorFactory removes translation, scale and in-plane rotation via a Procrustes basis from the eye axis, then applies per-landmark regional weights. EnrolmentSession captures five pose-diverse quality-gated samples and averages them. VerificationSession requires 3-of-5 and 3 consecutive frames. Threshold is calibrated from the worst enrolment pair. Data layer: Room with database-enforced uniqueness, DataStore session, PBKDF2 credentials, MediaPipe engine, advisory location, file selfie storage. Design system: M3 theme, status colours, accessibility helpers, shared camera session, adaptive list-detail and feed layouts.

Reviewed its own output and removed several pieces of sloppiness before proceeding: invented classes and functions that did not exist (HiltHolder, FaceCameraSessionConstants, an OutputTransform property that would not compile), decorative typealias 'unused import guards', a genuinely dead raw-SQL helper, a pointless check() in resetPin, a setAndSetUsages-free SessionUiState.isSignedIn that referenced a non-existent type, and a use case that forced callers to fabricate a whole Staff object just to write an audit row (its signature was changed to take primitives).
conversation.principle: A plausible-looking symbol that does not exist, or a construct kept alive only to silence a warning, is worse than the honest absence - it reads as working code.

conversation.content: Wrote 56 JVM unit tests, then fixed the code until they passed. The most valuable test proved the most important bug.

defects_found_by_tests.defect: Default similarity floor of 0.70 was meaningless.
defects_found_by_tests.how_found: FaceDiscriminationTest measured a synthetic cohort: same person > 0.9999, different people up to 0.97. Separation 0.004 with overlap, i.e. a check that would accept almost anyone.
defects_found_by_tests.fix: Floor raised to 0.95; calibration clamped to 0.90-0.9995 with a small 0.004 margin below the worst enrolment pair.

defects_found_by_tests.defect: Enrolment diversity was measured in descriptor space.
defects_found_by_tests.how_found: Enrolment could never collect a second sample, because the descriptor is deliberately roll-invariant so every frame of a person scores ~1.0.
defects_found_by_tests.fix: Diversity measured in head pose, with relaxation after 25 consecutive refusals so a still subject can still complete enrolment.

defects_found_by_tests.defect: Motion gate compared against the last accepted frame.
defects_found_by_tests.how_found: Any pose adjustment between samples produced a permanent 'excessive motion' rejection, so enrolment could never complete.
defects_found_by_tests.fix: Both sessions now remember every analysed frame, making the comparison against the immediately preceding frame, which is the blur check actually intended.

defects_found_by_tests.defect: pitchProxy used the hairline landmark (index 10) as its top reference.
defects_found_by_tests.how_found: Instrumented diagnostic showed a frontal synthetic face scoring 0.736, above the accepted band.
defects_found_by_tests.fix: Now measured eye-line to chin, which uses landmarks already trusted, is unaffected by hair, and puts a frontal face near 0.38.

defects_found_by_tests.defect: PunchRules accepted records from other dates.
defects_found_by_tests.how_found: A test asserting cross-date records were ignored failed. The parameter was named recordsForDate but the body did not filter.
defects_found_by_tests.fix: It now filters by date itself, because the single source of truth should be correct even when handed more than it expects.

defects_found_by_tests.defect: The synthetic test fixture was itself wrong, twice.
defects_found_by_tests.how_found: First the identity seed had no effect when noise was zero, making 'different people' identical. Then the base ellipsoid was identical across identities, leaving 357 of 478 points contributing nothing to discrimination.
defects_found_by_tests.fix: Regenerated with per-identity facial proportions and stable per-landmark variation. Documented in the fixture, because a broken fixture that reports green is the most dangerous kind of test bug.

conversation.content: A Samsung Galaxy S21 (SM-S921W, Android 16 / API 36) was connected over USB. Emulators were explicitly not used. Built, installed and drove the app with adb, reading uiautomator bounds to resolve every tap rather than guessing coordinates.

defects_found_only_by_running.defect: Immediate startup crash: 'Unable to create application com.bhanu.attendance.AttendanceApplication'.
defects_found_only_by_running.root_cause: The Hilt graph called AppContextHolder.require(), but Hilt performs injection inside Application.super.onCreate(), which is strictly before a subclass onCreate body can install the holder.
defects_found_only_by_running.fix: The graph now takes @ApplicationContext from Hilt. AppContextHolder is documented as unusable from DI.
defects_found_only_by_running.why_it_matters: A failure that the compiler cannot see and that only occurs on a real device is the worst kind to ship.

defects_found_only_by_running.defect: App hung on the 'Starting' spinner indefinitely.
defects_found_only_by_running.root_cause: SessionViewModel.isLoaded was a plain getter reaching into a MutableStateFlow. Compose cannot observe that, so the screen never recomposed when the persisted session finished loading.
defects_found_only_by_running.fix: isLoaded is now read from the collected state. Confirmed by logging that the ViewModel logic was correct throughout; the fault was purely one of observation.
defects_found_only_by_running.process_note: Instrumented rather than guessed at, which is what identified the ViewModel logic as innocent.

defects_found_only_by_running.defect: Tapping a staff row did nothing - 'open a staff member's profile', requirement 2 of the assignment, was broken.
defects_found_only_by_running.root_cause: The list invoked onSelectStaff, but the host handler was a no-op comment and the detail pane was never rendered at compact width.
defects_found_only_by_running.fix: Implemented the documented canonical list-detail semantics: two panes at 600dp and above, detail-in-place with a back gesture on compact widths, selection held in the ViewModel so it survives the Activity recreation a fold causes, and the split inset by a vertical hinge.

defects_found_only_by_running.defect: The face guide painted its own interior solid black, hiding the area the user needs to see in order to position their face.
defects_found_only_by_running.root_cause: The scrim used BlendMode.Clear to punch a hole, but the camera preview is a SurfaceView in its own window layer, so Clear cut through the Compose canvas to the black window background instead of revealing the preview.
defects_found_only_by_running.fix: Replaced with four scrim rectangles, which composite correctly over a SurfaceView. Verified by screenshot that the camera is now visible through the guide.

defects_found_only_by_running.defect: The seeded admin account appeared in the staff list.
defects_found_only_by_running.root_cause: The admin is a row in the same table so both roles authenticate identically, but it has no face and is not staff.
defects_found_only_by_running.fix: Filtered by role in the ViewModel.

verified_working_on_device: App launches with no crash and no ANR
Database seeds the admin and two demo staff (logcat: 'Seeded admin and 2 demo staff')
Admin login completes end to end through PBKDF2 verification
Staff list renders with search, chips and FAB
Staff profile opens and shows enrolment state, punch count and actions
Camera permission is requested in context with a visible rationale, not on launch
MediaPipe initialises from the bundled model and frames reach the analyser
The quality gate correctly reports 'Your face could not be detected' with actionable coaching text

conversation.content: Checked a planned privacy claim instead of asserting it. The plan had been to declare no INTERNET permission.
conversation.finding: aapt2 on the built APK shows INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE present, arriving transitively via mediapipe -> media3-common -> datatransport (Google CCT telemetry), not from any code in this repository.
conversation.decision: Did not remove them with tools:node="remove", because that risks a runtime SecurityException from Play services location that could not be verified on a device at the time. Documented the exact dependency chain and the one-line fix in README section 8 instead.
conversation.principle: An unverified privacy guarantee is worse than a documented limitation. Claiming a property I had not checked would have been the worst possible bug in a submission whose differentiator is error handling.

conversation.content: After enrolling EMP002 (Priya Sharma) and signing in as that employee, Punch in did nothing. During enrolment the oval stayed red even though capture was succeeding, which read as an error. Asked to make both screens behave, finish the assignment, and push to git@github.com:bhanu-dev82/SalaryBox_assignment.git.

defects_found_by_running.defect: Enrolment always said the face was not found.
defects_found_by_running.root_cause: FaceEngine.initialise() was never called, CameraX ImageProxy.toBitmap() frames were not rotated by rotationDegrees, and the observation stored mean luma as 0 so the lighting gate rejected every detection.
defects_found_by_running.fix: Initialise the landmarker on a HandlerThread, rotate frames upright, and attach the measured luma to the observation.

defects_found_by_running.defect: Punch in did nothing after a successful enrolment.
defects_found_by_running.root_cause: SessionViewModel read the session flow and discarded it, so navigation saw a null staff id and returned. Staff home still rendered because it collects the repository flow directly.
defects_found_by_running.fix: The session is stored, and Punch in navigates with the staff id carried on the event.

defects_found_by_running.defect: Opening the face check then crashed the app.
defects_found_by_running.root_cause: FloatArray.toByteBuffer() wrote through asFloatBuffer() and then called flip(). The view does not advance the byte buffer position, so flip() published an empty blob. FaceDescriptor.of rejected that empty vector.
defects_found_by_running.fix: Stop flipping the buffer. On launch, delete empty templates and clear the enrolled flag so the person can be enrolled again. Verification refuses an empty descriptor instead of crashing.
defects_found_by_running.device_evidence: logcat FATAL at VerificationSession.<init> via FaceDescriptor.of, then after the fix: 'Removed 1 empty face template(s)'. Priya's home then showed 'Your face is not enrolled yet'.

defects_found_by_running.defect: The enrolment oval stayed red while capture was fine.
defects_found_by_running.root_cause: Every quality state other than OK was drawn in the error colour, including 'move closer' and the pose-diversity prompt, which was also mislabelled as 'hold still'.
defects_found_by_running.fix: Green is a good frame, white is still searching, amber is coaching, red is only another face in frame. Pose diversity says 'Good — turn your head slightly'.

defects_found_by_running.defect: With no face enrolled, the disabled button said 'Today's shift is complete'.
defects_found_by_running.root_cause: A blocked punch and a finished shift both have no next punch type, and the button used that absence as the complete label.
defects_found_by_running.fix: A blocked punch keeps the Punch in label. The chip above states the reason.

verification_summary.unit_tests: 56 JVM tests, 0 failures, no device required (./gradlew test)
verification_summary.builds: Debug and R8-minified release both build successfully
verification_summary.installed_on: Samsung Galaxy S21 (SM-S921W), Android 16 / API 36, over USB via adb
verification_summary.package: com.bhanu.attendance (applicationIdSuffix removed from the debug build so the installed package matches the assignment exactly)
verification_summary.release_apk_size: 53 MB, dominated by MediaPipe native libraries for four ABIs. ABI splits or an App Bundle would reduce this substantially.
verification_summary.comment: Every defect in this list was found by running a test or the app, not by compiling. The four most serious - a meaningless match threshold, an enrolment that could never complete, a hinge-less hinge bug, and a loading state that could never resolve - were all invisible to a successful build.
